title: Close Combat
subtitle: Fight phase: pile in, pick a weapon, swing, take it back

bullets: The Fight phase opens with [b]Pile In[/b] — pick a unit, shuffle every model up to 3" closer, then [b]Confirm Move[/b]. Only models within 2" of the enemy get to swing, so this is how you get the back rank into the fight. [b]End Pile In[/b] passes your half.
Click a unit in [b]UNITS THAT CAN FIGHT[/b] to activate it. Units that charged swing first — [b]all[/b] of them, before the enemy gets a turn.
A Warboss leading a squad is [b]part of that squad[/b] — one row, [b]Boyz + Warboss[/b], and they fight in the [b]same[/b] activation. He doesn't get a swing of his own.

In the attack panel each [b]group[/b] of models picks its own weapon and target — the squad's choppas, the Nob's big choppa and the [b]Warboss's Power klaw[/b], all in the one panel. Then [b]Fight![/b]
The dice dock rolls it out — [b]Fast Roll ⏩[/b] does the lot, [b]Done ✔[/b] finishes the activation.
Then the enemy activates and the dock rolls [b]their[/b] hits and wounds at you — you roll the saves and can spend a [b]Command Re-roll[/b].
You and the enemy alternate activations till everyone has swung. Last lesson: Running the Show.

Click a unit in [b]UNITS THAT CAN FIGHT[/b] to activate it. Units dat charged swing first — [b]all[/b] of 'em, before da enemy gets a look in.
A Warboss leadin' a mob is [b]part of dat mob[/b] — one row, [b]Boyz + Warboss[/b], an' dey krump in da [b]same[/b] activation. He don't get a swing of his own.
In da attack panel each [b]group[/b] of models picks its own weapon an' target — da mob's choppas, da Nob's big choppa an' da [b]Warboss's Power klaw[/b], all in da one panel. Den [b]Fight![/b]

You an' da enemy alternate activations till everyone's swung. Last lesson: Runnin' da Show.

prompt.text: The Boyz and the Warboss made it in — now they get to fight. The boss is [b]leading[/b] that squad, so they're [b]one unit[/b]: one row in the list, one activation, and they all swing together. Every engaged unit fights once, and units that [b]charged[/b] all go before the enemy does. It starts with a [b]Pile In[/b] step.

rewind_when.comment: The player backed out of the attack panel (CANCEL_FIGHTER_SELECTION). No unit is activated, no dialog is up and the picker is back on screen — so this card's 'pick a weapon' instructions describe a panel that is gone. Walk the lesson back to the fighter pick instead of stranding them.
